in_marathi.name: Ashokkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashokkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashokkumar is a combination of two words: Ashoka (unconquered) and Kumar (young prince). This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and holds significant historical meaning in Hindu mythology.
